_why: Reimplements the organisers' tools/check-safety.js contract so `npm run check` works with zero dependencies. Theirs needs Ajv; ours validates the two things that actually matter and refuses to grow a dependency tree.
notes: No real abuse-related search terms may appear anywhere in this repo, ever - including examples, tests, fixtures and comments.
A file whose name looks like a trigger/keyword list is a fail unless it is in allowedTriggerFiles, even if its contents are innocuous.
